vehicleDetails.title: Rizta S Pro
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather Rizta S Pro series is designed to redefine the family electric scooter segment, prioritizing space, comfort, and intelligent convenience. Built on a platform that emphasizes a wide, ergonomic seat and a low center of gravity, this series delivers a stable and luxurious riding experience for both the rider and the pillion. By integrating Ather’s proven electric powertrain with the premium "Pro" software suite, the Rizta S Pro ensures that your family journeys are safe, comfortable, and deeply connected.

The Ather Rizta S Pro Lineup

The series offers two specialized configurations, each optimized to provide a unique balance of endurance and power for your daily needs.

Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh)

The 2.9 kWh variant is the ideal solution for frequent, shorter-distance city commuting, offering a perfect blend of agility and efficiency.

  • Battery Capacity: 2.9 kWh
  • Certified Range (IDC): 123 km
  • Top Speed: 80 km/h

Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh)

The 3.7 kWh variant serves as the endurance flagship, designed for families who require extended range for longer commutes and inter-city travel.

  • Battery Capacity: 3.7 kWh
  • Certified Range (IDC): 159 km
  • Top Speed: 80 km/h

Advanced Engineering & Connectivity

The Ather Rizta S Pro series is engineered to provide a premium, feature-rich experience for every family journey:

  • Comfort-First Architecture: Featuring the largest seat in the category, the series is designed to accommodate two adults comfortably. The chassis is optimized for stability, ensuring a planted and smooth ride even with a full load.
  • Smart "Pro" Interface: The series features a high-visibility, 7-inch TFT touchscreen display. With the Pro package, riders benefit from Google Maps navigation, smartphone connectivity, music controls, and real-time ride analytics, all integrated seamlessly into the dashboard.
  • Safety & Convenience: The Rizta S Pro is equipped with advanced safety tech, including AutoHold™ for inclines, FallSafe™ to cut power in the event of a tip-over, and SkidControl™ for superior traction on varying road surfaces. It also includes "Magic Twist™" for regenerative braking and an ample 34-liter boot for total practicality.
  • Secure Connectivity: With the Ather App, users get access to live vehicle status, remote charging tracking, and theft/tow alerts, ensuring your vehicle is always protected and ready to go.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta S Pro Series?

The Ather Rizta S Pro series is the definitive choice for families who refuse to compromise on comfort or smart technology. By combining a wide, ergonomic design with an advanced software suite and reliable electric range, these scooters make every family errand or commute effortless and enjoyable. Whether you prioritize the agile 2.9 kWh variant or the unparalleled endurance of the 3.7 kWh flagship, the Rizta S Pro delivers an unmatched blend of safety, space, and essential smart features on every journey.

variantData.title: Rizta S pro 2.9 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) hits the perfect sweet spot for families who want intelligent technology without paying for a premium touchscreen interface. It takes the highly practical, spacious foundation of the standard Rizta S and completely unlocks its digital potential via the integrated Pro Pack. Designed for the modern urban family, this variant offers massive cargo space, class-leading seating comfort, and a fully connected dashboard that safely guides you through city traffic while keeping you synced with your smartphone.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Pro Pack Connectivity: The Pro package brings the rugged 7-inch DeepView™ LCD Console to life. It unlocks crucial smart features including Bluetooth connectivity for call and music controls, WhatsApp notifications directly on the dash, and seamless Turn-by-Turn navigation via the Ather App.
  • Advanced Rider Assists: Upgrading to the Pro version gives you essential safety tools like AutoHold™, which keeps the scooter perfectly still on steep flyovers without needing to hold the brakes, and FallSafe™ technology.
  • City-Optimized Range: Powered by a reliable 2.9 kWh Lithium-ion battery, it delivers a highly capable IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 123 km, providing plenty of mileage for daily school drops, office runs, and errands.
  • Smooth & Safe Powertrain: It utilizes a 4.3 kW PMSM motor producing 22 Nm of torque. It achieves a safe, comfortable top speed of 80 km/h and features Ather's smart riding modes (SmartEco, Zip) to optimize battery life on the go.
  • Unmatched Space: The Rizta S Pro retains the family-first physical design, featuring a massive 900mm long seat and a cavernous 34-liter under-seat boot, easily accommodating helmets and weekly groceries.

Where Does the S Pro Fit?

The Ather Rizta family offers diverse configurations. Here is how the connected Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) compares to its closest Rizta S and Rizta Z siblings to help you choose the right fit for your family.

1. Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta S (2.9 kWh): The Software Advantage

This is the most direct comparison: the standard model versus the fully unlocked model.

  • Hardware Parity: Both scooters are physically identical, sharing the exact same 2.9 kWh battery (123 km range), massive 900mm seat, and the physical DeepView™ LCD screen.
  • The "Pro" Difference: The standard Ather Rizta S 2.9 kwh provides a basic digital experience. The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) unlocks the dashboard's true potential, giving you Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, ride telemetry on your phone, and the highly convenient AutoHold™ feature for inclines.
  • Verdict: If you just want a straightforward scooter for local runs, the standard Rizta S is great. If you want navigation assistance and the safety of AutoHold™ while carrying your family, the Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) is the mandatory upgrade.

2. Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh): Display & Pillion Comfort

This comparison determines whether you prefer tactile LCD switches or a premium touchscreen cabin.

  • Shared Tech & Range: Both models utilize the 2.9 kWh battery (123 km range), operate on the 4.3 kW motor, and offer smart connectivity features.
  • The "Z" Factor: The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) uses the highly durable, physical DeepView™ LCD screen and a standard long seat. The Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) upgrades the experience to a full-color 7-inch TFT Touchscreen with built-in Google Maps and adds a dedicated pillion backrest for enhanced passenger luxury.
  • Verdict: Choose the Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) if you want all the smart features on a highly durable, glare-free physical display. Upgrade to the Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) if you prefer a smartphone-like interactive screen and frequently ride with a passenger who needs a backrest.

3. Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh): The Ultimate Technology Leap

Comparing this model to the fully loaded "Z Pro" highlights the absolute extremes of the 2.9 kWh battery platform.

  • Display Technology: The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) relies on turn-by-turn navigation via the LCD. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) features the fully unlocked TFT Touchscreen with full Google Maps integration.
  • Traction & Safety: While the S Pro has AutoHold™, the Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) goes a step further by unlocking Ather's advanced SkidControl™ system, preventing wheel slip on wet or gravelly roads.
  • Verdict: The Z Pro is for the tech enthusiast who wants everything Ather can possibly engineer into the dashboard. The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) remains the pragmatic, high-value choice for the family that wants essential connectivity and navigation without paying for the highest-tier screens or advanced traction control.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) is the smartest investment for families who want modern conveniences on a budget. It strategically provides the most important software upgrades—like navigation, AutoHold™, and phone connectivity—without forcing you to pay for expensive touchscreens or larger battery packs you might not need. It is a spacious, highly connected, and incredibly practical workhorse built specifically for the Indian family.

variantData.title: Rizta S Pro 3.7 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the ultimate pragmatic choice for the modern, tech-conscious family. It perfectly combines Ather’s largest available battery pack with the fully unlocked software capabilities of the Pro Pack, all displayed on the highly durable, non-touch LCD screen. Designed for families who demand massive driving range and essential smart connectivity—without the premium price tag of a touchscreen—this scooter ensures that long daily commutes are safe, perfectly navigated, and exceptionally comfortable.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Flagship Battery & Range: The heart of this variant is the massive 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery. It completely eliminates range anxiety by delivering an outstanding 159 km IDC range, easily handling multiple days of city commuting, school drops, and errands on a single charge.
  • Pro Pack Connectivity: The Pro package brings the highly durable 7-inch DeepView™ LCD Console to life. It unlocks crucial smart features including Bluetooth connectivity for call and music controls, WhatsApp notifications, and Turn-by-Turn navigation directly on your dashboard.
  • Essential Rider Assists: The software upgrade introduces advanced safety tools critical for carrying family members, such as AutoHold™ (keeping the scooter perfectly still on steep flyovers without holding the brakes) and FallSafe™ technology.
  • Smooth & Capable Powertrain: It is driven by a dependable 4.3 kW PMSM motor with 22 Nm of torque. It achieves a safe, comfortable top speed of 80 km/h and grants access to Ather's intelligent riding modes (SmartEco, Zip) to optimize your 159 km range on the go.
  • Unmatched Space: It retains the Rizta's hallmark physical features: a massive 900mm long seat (the largest in its class), a spacious flat footboard, and a cavernous 34-liter under-seat boot for maximum cargo capability.

Choosing Your Rizta

The Ather Rizta family offers diverse configurations. Here is how the high-endurance Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) compares to its closest "S" and "Z" siblings to help you find the exact right fit.

1. Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather Rizta S (3.7 kWh): The Software Advantage

This comparison determines whether you just want the big battery, or if you want it to be "smart."

  • Hardware Parity: Both scooters are physically identical, sharing the massive 3.7 kWh battery (159 km range), the 900mm seat, the 34L boot, and the physical DeepView™ LCD screen.
  • The "Pro" Difference: The standard Ather Rizta S (3.7 kWh) provides a basic digital experience. The Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) unlocks the dashboard's true potential, giving you Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, ride telemetry on your smartphone, and the highly convenient AutoHold™ feature for inclines.
  • Verdict: If you just want maximum range on a budget, the standard Rizta S is great. If you want navigation assistance and the safety of AutoHold™ while carrying your family over long distances, the Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the mandatory upgrade.

2. Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh): The Range Revolution

This comparison is for buyers who know they want the "S Pro" tech but are deciding on battery size.

  • Shared Connectivity: Both models feature the exact same fully unlocked DeepView™ display, Bluetooth navigation, AutoHold™, and smart riding modes.
  • The Endurance Gap: The 2.9 kWh version gives you a city-centric 123 km IDC range. The Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) elevates the game to the flagship battery, offering a massive 159 km IDC range—giving you roughly 36 km of additional driving distance per charge.
  • Verdict: If your daily travel is brief and predictable, the 2.9 kWh model is perfectly capable. However, if you hate charging your scooter frequently or have massive daily commutes, the Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the definitive choice.

3. Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh): The Display & Pillion Leap

Comparing this model to the fully loaded "Z Pro" highlights the difference between tactile practicality and premium luxury.

  • Shared Endurance: Both scooters share the identical 3.7 kWh battery pack, offering the same stellar 159 km driving range, along with smart features like navigation and AutoHold™.
  • The "Z" Factor: The Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the physical LCD display and a standard long seat. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) upgrades the experience to a full-color 7-inch TFT Touchscreen with built-in Google Maps, adds advanced SkidControl™ (traction control), and includes a dedicated pillion backrest.
  • Verdict: The Z Pro is for the tech enthusiast who wants everything Ather can possibly engineer into the cabin. The Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) remains the pragmatic, high-value choice for the family that wants essential connectivity and maximum distance without paying for the highest-tier touchscreen.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh)?

The Ather Rizta S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the smartest long-term investment for the modern family. It focuses your budget on the two things that matter most: the absolute largest battery available for uncompromised 159 km range, and the essential software (Navigation, AutoHold™) needed to make daily riding safer and easier. It skips the expensive touchscreen to deliver a highly durable, connected, and incredibly spacious workhorse.
